thesis: The speaker argues that the tech stack for asset management firms is becoming increasingly complex, adding risk and headcount, and suggests Ridgeline offers a unified platform to automate this complexity. The conversation also explores the history of Second Life, a virtual world the speaker co-founded, noting its evolution from a 'Burning Man' style open world to a profitable platform with over 500,000 paying users.
